pairs.question: Unde dicta est rhetorica?
pairs.answer: Apo tou retoreuein, id est copia locutionis.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker [3] and speaker labels K./A. Self-contained interrogative with full direct answer; nothing cut.

pairs.question: In quibus versatur rebus?
pairs.answer: In civilibus, id est doctis quaestionibus, quae naturali animi ingenio concipi possunt.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker and speaker labels. Answer ends at first full stop; the following sentences (Nam sicut naturale est...) elaborate rather than answer, so they are cut.

pairs.question: Quot personae solent in iudiciis esse?
pairs.answer: Quattuor: accusator causae, defensor causae, testes, iudex.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker [16] and speaker labels. Self-contained interrogative, complete direct answer; nothing cut.

pairs.question: Quid est exordium?
pairs.answer: Oratio animum auditoris idonee conparans ad reliquam dictionem.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker [20] and speaker labels. Definitional question with full answer; nothing cut.

pairs.question: Quomodo hoc efficitur?
pairs.answer: Primo ut benivolum, attentum, docilem efficias auditorem.
pairs.derivation: Stripped speaker labels. The antecedent of 'hoc' (efficere exordium) is the immediately preceding exchange; answer is complete and contiguous, nothing cut.

pairs.question: Quot sunt causarum genera?
pairs.answer: Quinque: honestum, admirabile, humile, anceps, obscurum.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker [21] and speaker labels. Self-contained interrogative, complete enumerated answer; the following sentences defining each genus are elaboration and are cut.

pairs.question: Quid efficit indignatio?
pairs.answer: Odium in adversarium vel offensionem in eius causam.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker [33] and speaker labels. Self-contained interrogative with complete direct answer; nothing cut.

pairs.question: Quae sit ipsa virtus.
pairs.answer: Virtus est animi habitus, naturae decus, vitae ratio, morum nobilitas.
pairs.derivation: From the request 'primum dic, quae sit ipsa virtus' (the framing 'primum dic' is dropped as a speech tag); answer is the complete definition, nothing cut. Section marker and labels stripped.

pairs.question: Quae est prudentia?
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker [44] and speaker labels. Self-contained definitional interrogative with full answer; nothing cut.

pairs.question: Quomodo ex naturae iure?
pairs.answer: Quia partes illius quaedam naturae vis inserit, ut relegionem, pietatem, gratiam, vindicationem, observantiam, veritatem.
pairs.derivation: Stripped section marker and labels. The question elliptically continues the prior answer (iustitia partim ex naturae iure); the reply is complete and contiguous, nothing cut.
